title: SemTrace: Source-Grounded Semantic Signatures for Tracing LLM Exposure to Protected Documents
abstract: arXiv:2608.29575v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to read documents and produce downstream text, creating a provenance problem when the document owner cannot control or inspect the model that performs the generation. We introduce SemTrace, a source-grounded semantic watermark for detecting whether a generated review was influenced by a known protected manuscript copy. Rather than biasing token probabilities or imposing surface-form patterns, SemTrace constructs a document-specific binary signature from factual propositions that are directly supported by the manuscript itself. A protected PDF invisibly carries a content contract that selects one fact from each binary pair and asks an instruction-following reviewer to express those facts in fixed review slots without changing its independent evaluation. A frozen natural language inference model then decodes the resulting semantic evidence with explicit erasures and scores the recovered bits agai

translated_title: SemTrace：用于追踪大语言模型接触受保护文档的源锚定语义签名
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于阅读文档并生成下游文本，当文档所有者无法控制或审查执行生成任务的模型时，便产生了来源追溯问题。我们提出了SemTrace，一种源锚定的语义水印，用于检测生成的评审是否受到了已知的受保护手稿副本的影响。SemTrace并不通过偏置词元概率或强加表面形式模式来实现，而是从手稿本身直接支持的事实命题中构建文档特定的二进制签名。受保护的PDF以不可见的方式携带一个内容契约，该契约从每个二进制对中选择一个事实，并要求遵循指令的评审者在固定的评审槽位中表达这些事实，同时不改变其独立评审结论。随后，一个冻结的自然语言推理模型对由此产生的语义证据进行解码（包含显式擦除），并对恢复出的比特进行评分……
tldr: 提出了SemTrace，一种源锚定的语义水印方法，通过在受保护文档中嵌入基于事实命题的内容契约，让评审模型在固定槽位中表达所选事实，再利用冻结的自然语言推理模型解码语义证据，从而检测生成的评审是否受到受保护手稿副本的影响。
en_tdlr: SemTrace is a source-grounded semantic watermark that embeds fact-based binary content contracts in protected documents and decodes semantic evidence from generated reviews using a frozen NLI model, enabling detection of LLM exposure to protected manuscripts.
